meta.title: Asyncio Cancellation
meta.goal: Design and verify cancellation-safe asyncio components

stages.title: Cancellation foundations
stages.description: Build the task-lifecycle model required for safe cancellation.

nodes.title: Task cancellation semantics
nodes.summary: Understand how cancellation is requested, delivered, propagated, and observed.
learning_outcomes: Explain when CancelledError is injected into a task

foundation.title: Coroutines and Tasks
foundation.why: Defines Task.cancel, CancelledError, TaskGroup, and cancellation behaviour.

practice.title: Preserve cancellation during cleanup
practice.task: Implement a coroutine that releases a resource when cancelled and still propagates cancellation.
practice.deliverable: A Python module and deterministic tests
practice.allowed_assistance: Official documentation allowed; AI review only after tests pass

completion_criteria: Predict the observable state of a task before and after cancel()

anki_cards.front: What does asyncio.Task.cancel() do before the task reaches its next suspension point?
anki_cards.back: It requests cancellation; CancelledError is injected on the next event-loop cycle rather than terminating the task immediately.
